title: Step 64-D profile, account security and customer-owned Address management
description: HIGH-risk Step 64-D. Productionize SF-E-02 /account/profile and SF-E-03 /account/addresses using canonical generated contracts, server-only CustomerSessionBridge transport, bounded profile fields, account session logout controls, customer-owned Address CRUD/default operations and canonical Iran 1404 geography. Do not invent OTP/step-up, mobile editing, backend rules, API/database changes, or Step 64-E+ functionality.

dependencies.evidence: PR #321 merged as 8cbc8fa1c0598f9a3ab819f2468563349fe8b6be; protected Merge Policy workflow_dispatch 37458610700 succeeded; exact-SHA postmerge verification job 112252402620 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6015856178.

acceptance_criteria.description: SF-E-02 /account/profile reads the authenticated customer profile from the canonical generated contract and permits only first_name, last_name and email updates. Mobile, customer type, status and server-owned identity fields are not editable.

Account security exposes only contract-authorized current-session and all-session logout controls. No frontend-invented password, OTP, step-up, session identifier, permission or token authority is introduced.
SF-E-03 /account/addresses lists only customer-owned addresses and supports create, update, delete and set-default using canonical APIs and required idempotency keys.
Address province and city values come only from the canonical Iran 1404 reference and every submitted province-city pair is revalidated server-side before an Address API mutation.
401 fails closed to unauthenticated presentation; 403/404 ownership-denied states leak no other-customer existence/content; 409 and uncertain failures never manufacture mutation success.
Customer session cookies remain server-only through CustomerSessionBridge; credentials/tokens do not enter URLs, browser storage, analytics or user-visible diagnostics.
Persian RTL UI has semantic labels/errors/status, 44px targets, visible focus and responsive single-column reflow without brown palette additions.
No backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency/Product Design/Current-State mutation is introduced and Step 64-E+ routes remain deferred.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 64-D is HIGH risk because it mutates authenticated customer profile/session and owned address state. Final Project Owner HUMAN approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact after technical/security gates are green. Direct-main/raw merge prohibited.
